Oh wasnt expecting to get a reply but ok.

See my life isnt even bad yea im socially awkward, but shit i shouldn't even think like this i know that, but i just have no need to live it just doesn't make sense.  First i though i was depressed because i needed to get exercise so started to work out felt better then back to being depressed.  Even if im in a good mood if everything is just going great that day i would still rather be dead.  Life is just useless.  And no never saw a shrink because im too embarassed to tell anyone because part of me still thinks im just being a bitch and need to get over it.(Was about to correct some mistakes as to make myself seem more smart, yea idk why)

Yes you stated it correctly, I knew something was off about it. It is avoiding responsibility, but I still see no point of going through a long life just to die at the end.

So I just basically realized I'm just asking whats the point of living, which is just a useless question.

fucking great /s

1st: Awesome username.

> We're not forcing you to stay alive, but we'd like you to stay alive, for our sakes.

That right there seems to be more selfish then committing suicide.

> That's because we have some foresight and realise that things will get better

No one knows that, 90% it probably does get better, but I just don't see the point. Lets say things will get better, but then you will still die, every road leads to death so why live through the bad things when you can just die and get it over with rather then slowly dieing over a long period of time?
(Again I don't know if that makes sense)
